adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, when `uniqueGuests.length === 0` (i.e., all provided emails are already attendees and/or are blacklisted), the server throws `TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "emails_must_be_unique_valid" })`. The client toast uses `t(err.message)`, so the user sees “Emails must be unique and valid”, which does not accurately describe the server-side failure condition (no new non-blacklisted guests to add).
